rawContent: @brantooni @ConstanceWu The "believe women" line is a throwaway effort to connect being unhappy about her TV job to the #metoo movement. Superbly bad form.

@porquesoybello "Believe women" is only in our lexicon due to the brave women sharing their stories of sexual assault. It applies to women of all colors. Assault is not a race issue nor a Virginia issue. Or a y'all issue. Constance hijacked the line to explain her Tweet hissy fit. #metoo
